blocks.text: each va every — «har bir», lekin ikki xil nigoh

O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham ko'pincha «**har bir**» deb tarjima qilinadi va ko'p gaplarda ular o'rnini almashtiraveradi: **Each** room has a TV = **Every** room has a TV. Lekin nigoh boshqacha. **every** — guruhga **bir butun** sifatida qaraydi: «hammasi, istisnosiz» (every = all). **each** — guruh a'zolarini **birma-bir, alohida-alohida** ko'radi: «har biri o'z navbatida». Shuning uchun **every** katta guruh va umumiy fikrlarga, **each** esa kichik guruh va har biriga alohida qilinadigan harakatga ko'proq mos keladi. Ikkalasidan keyin ham ot va fe'l **birlikda**: every / each student **has**.

**Faqat each:** 1) **ikkita** narsa haqida — every kamida uchta narsani talab qiladi: a ring on **each** hand (ikkala qo'lida), houses on **each** side of the road; 2) otsiz, gap oxirida yoki egadan keyin (pastroqqa qarang). **Faqat every:** 1) **almost / nearly / practically every** — deyarli har bir; 2) **son** bilan: every **two** weeks, every **ten** minutes; 3) **every other** (bir ... ora), **every single** (bittasini ham qoldirmay); 4) umumlashtiruvchi fikrda: **Every** child needs love — bu yerda each g'alati eshitiladi.

items.text: The boy had a balloon in **each** hand.
items.translation: Bolaning **ikkala** qo'lida bittadan sharcha bor edi.

items.text: **Almost every** house in the street has solar panels now.
items.translation: Hozir ko'chadagi **deyarli har bir** uyda quyosh panellari bor.

items.text: The nurse spoke to **each** patient before the operation.
items.translation: Hamshira operatsiyadan oldin **har bir** bemor bilan alohida gaplashdi.

blocks.text: each of, every one of va everyone

**each** dan keyin **of** + the / my / these / them keladi: **each of** the students, **each of** us. Fe'l **birlikda**, chunki egaga each mos: Each of them **has** a key. **every** dan keyin esa of to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelmaydi — «every of» xato; uning o'rniga **every one of**: **every one of** the cakes. Ikki so'zli **every one** (har bittasi) va bir so'zli **everyone** (hamma odam) ni chalkashtirmang: **Everyone** loved the cakes, and **every one** of them was eaten. **each other** (bir-birini) haqida — 82-darsda (→ 82-dars).

items.text: **Each of** my sisters **has** a different job.
**Every one of** these old photos tells a story.
items.translation: Bu eski suratlarning **har biri** bir voqeani so'zlaydi.

items.text: The coach shook hands with **each of** us after the match.
items.translation: O'yindan keyin murabbiy **har birimiz** bilan qo'l berib ko'rishdi.

blocks.text: each otsiz: gapning o'rtasida va oxirida

**each** ot yoki of siz ham keladi, every esa bunday kelmaydi. Uch o'rni bor: 1) **gap oxirida**, narx yoki miqdordan keyin: The tickets are ten pounds **each** (donasi o'n funt); 2) **egadan keyin**, asosiy fe'ldan oldin: They **each** have a car; 3) **be** yoki yordamchi fe'ldan keyin: We were **each** given a map; They have **each** paid. O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha «**har biri**», «**donasi**», «**bittadan**» to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: Aziz and Jasur **each** bought a new bike.
items.translation: Aziz ham, Jasur ham **bittadan** yangi velosiped sotib oldi.

items.text: The volunteers were **each** given a T-shirt and a badge.
items.translation: Ko'ngillilarning **har biriga** futbolka va nishon berildi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «every of the students» → **each of** / **every one of** the students; «each students», «every days» → **each student**, **every day** (birlik!); «Each of them have» → Each of them **has**; «a bag in every hand» (ikki qo'l) → in **each** hand; «almost each day» → **almost every** day; «They cost five pounds every» → five pounds **each**.

Shubha bo'lsa, o'zingizdan so'rang: «**birma-bir** ko'ryapmanmi yoki **hammasini birga**mi?» Birma-bir, ikkita narsa yoki otsiz bo'lsa — **each**. Hammasi, deyarli hammasi, son bilan takror — **every**. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri keladigan gaplar ko'p — bu yerda xato qilish qiyin.

examples.title: **every**: all of them, no exceptions
examples.description: every — guruhning hammasi, istisnosiz; e'tibor umumiy manzarada. Ko'pincha katta guruh va umumiy fikrlar uchun: every country, every guest.

sentences.text: **Every** seat in the theatre was taken for the premiere.
sentences.translation: Premyerada teatrdagi **har bir** o'rindiq band edi.

sentences.text: She knows **every** shop in the old town by name.
sentences.translation: U eski shahardagi **har bir** do'konni nomi bilan biladi.

sentences.text: **Every** country in the region is suffering from the drought.
sentences.translation: Mintaqadagi **har bir** davlat qurg'oqchilikdan aziyat chekmoqda.

sentences.text: I've read **every** book by this author, and I'm waiting for the next one.
sentences.translation: Bu muallifning **har bir** kitobini o'qiganman, keyingisini kutyapman.

sentences.text: Kate remembers **every** detail of her wedding day.
sentences.translation: Keyt to'y kunining **har bir** tafsilotini eslaydi.

sentences.text: Our town has a park in **every** district, so families love living here.
sentences.translation: Shahrimizning **har bir** tumanida bog' bor, shuning uchun oilalar bu yerda yashashni yoqtiradi.

sentences.text: Not **every** idea works in practice, but it's worth trying.
sentences.translation: **Har bir** g'oya ham amalda ishlayvermaydi, lekin sinab ko'rishga arziydi.

sentences.text: The police checked **every** car leaving the city that night.
sentences.translation: O'sha kechasi politsiya shahardan chiqayotgan **har bir** mashinani tekshirdi.

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan, **every** guest is offered tea as soon as they arrive.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda **har bir** mehmonga kelishi bilanoq choy taklif qilinadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod has visited **every** region of the country except Karakalpakstan.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Qoraqalpog'istondan tashqari mamlakatning **har bir** viloyatida bo'lgan.

examples.title: **each**: one by one, separately
examples.description: each — guruhdagi har bir a'zo alohida-alohida, birma-bir ko'rib chiqiladi. Ko'pincha kichik guruh yoki har biriga alohida qilinadigan harakat.

sentences.text: The teacher spoke to **each** student about their progress.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi **har bir** talaba bilan uning yutuqlari haqida alohida gaplashdi.

sentences.text: **Each** guest received a small gift with their name on it.
sentences.translation: **Har bir** mehmon o'z ismi yozilgan kichik sovg'a oldi.

sentences.text: Read **each** question carefully before you answer.
sentences.translation: Javob berishdan oldin **har bir** savolni diqqat bilan o'qing.

sentences.text: The doctor examined **each** child in the group separately.
sentences.translation: Shifokor guruhdagi **har bir** bolani alohida ko'rikdan o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: **Each** apartment in the building has its own parking space.
sentences.translation: Binodagi **har bir** kvartiraning o'z avtoturargoh joyi bor.

sentences.text: Madina wrapped **each** present in different coloured paper.
sentences.translation: Madina **har bir** sovg'ani boshqa rangdagi qog'ozga o'radi.

sentences.text: At the interview, **each** candidate had twenty minutes to present their ideas.
sentences.translation: Suhbatda **har bir** nomzodga o'z g'oyalarini taqdim etish uchun yigirma daqiqa berildi.

sentences.text: The chef tastes **each** dish before it leaves the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Oshpaz **har bir** taomni oshxonadan chiqishidan oldin tatib ko'radi.

sentences.text: We discussed **each** option in detail, but we couldn't agree on anything.
sentences.translation: **Har bir** variantni batafsil muhokama qildik, lekin hech narsaga kelisha olmadik.

sentences.text: James has three daughters, and **each** one plays a different instrument.
sentences.translation: Jeymsning uchta qizi bor, ularning **har biri** boshqa-boshqa cholg'u chaladi.

examples.title: Only **each**: two things — **each** hand, **each** side
examples.description: Ikki narsa haqida faqat each ishlatiladi: each hand, each side, each end. every kamida uchta narsa uchun.

sentences.text: The baby was holding a toy in **each** hand.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **ikkala** qo'lida bittadan o'yinchoq ushlab turardi.

sentences.text: There's a security guard at **each** end of the bridge.
sentences.translation: Ko'prikning **har ikki** chetida qo'riqchi turadi.

sentences.text: In a tennis match, **each** player serves in turn.
sentences.translation: Tennis o'yinida **har bir** o'yinchi navbat bilan to'p oshiradi.

sentences.text: Jasur came back from the bazaar with a heavy bag in **each** hand.
sentences.translation: Jasur bozordan **ikkala** qo'lida bittadan og'ir sumka bilan qaytdi.

sentences.text: The two teams had **each** scored once by half-time.
sentences.translation: Tanaffusgacha ikkala jamoa **bittadan** gol urgan edi.

sentences.text: There are tall poplars on **each** side of the river.
sentences.translation: Daryoning **har ikki** tomonida baland teraklar bor.

sentences.text: My parents gave **each** of us — me and my brother — a laptop for university.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **har birimizga** — menga va akamga — universitet uchun noutbuk sovg'a qilishdi.

sentences.text: **Each** twin has a different personality, but they look identical.
sentences.translation: Egizaklarning **har biri** boshqa-boshqa fe'l-atvorga ega, lekin tashqi ko'rinishi bir xil.

sentences.text: The hotel room had two beds with a lamp beside **each** one.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonasida ikkita karavot bor edi, **har birining** yonida chiroq turardi.

sentences.text: Two ministers met in Geneva, and **each** brought a team of five advisers.
sentences.translation: Ikki vazir Jenevada uchrashdi, ularning **har biri** besh nafar maslahatchisi bilan keldi.

examples.title: Only **every**: **almost every**, **every** three days
examples.description: every keladi, each emas: almost / nearly / practically every; every + son (every three days); every other; every single. Shuningdek umumlashtiruvchi fikrlarda.

sentences.text: **Almost every** family in the village has a car now.
sentences.translation: Hozir qishloqdagi **deyarli har bir** oilaning mashinasi bor.

sentences.text: The tram comes **every ten minutes**, so there's no need to run.
sentences.translation: Tramvay **har o'n daqiqada** keladi, yugurishga hojat yo'q.

sentences.text: Nilufar has a piano lesson **every other** Saturday.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning pianino darsi **har ikkinchi** shanba kuni bo'ladi.

sentences.text: I've been to **nearly every** concert they've given in London.
sentences.translation: Ularning Londondagi **deyarli har bir** konsertida bo'lganman.

sentences.text: Change the water in the vase **every two days**, and the flowers will last longer.
sentences.translation: Guldondagi suvni **har ikki kunda** almashtiring, gullar uzoqroq turadi.

sentences.text: **Every single** person in the room turned to look at us.
sentences.translation: Xonadagi **har bir** odam, bittasi qolmay, bizga o'girilib qaradi.

sentences.text: **Practically every** student in the group failed the first test.
sentences.translation: Guruhdagi **deyarli har bir** talaba birinchi testdan yiqildi.

sentences.text: Sarah buys a new phone **every year**, and I think it's a waste of money.
sentences.translation: Sara **har yili** yangi telefon oladi, menimcha bu pulni sovurish.

sentences.text: There's a direct flight to Istanbul **every** morning at seven.
sentences.translation: **Har kuni** ertalab soat yettida Istanbulga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri reys bor.

sentences.text: **Every** child deserves a good education, wherever they live.
sentences.translation: Qayerda yashashidan qat'i nazar, **har bir** bola yaxshi ta'lim olishga haqli.

examples.title: **each of** / **every one of** + the, them
examples.description: each of + the / my / these / them — fe'l birlikda (each of them has). every of — xato: every one of. everyone (hamma odam) va every one (har bittasi) — boshqa-boshqa.

sentences.text: **Each of** the rooms **has** its own bathroom and balcony.
sentences.translation: Xonalarning **har birida** alohida hammom va balkon bor.

sentences.text: I've spoken to **each of** them, and they all agree.
sentences.translation: Ularning **har biri** bilan alohida gaplashdim, hammasi rozi.

sentences.text: **Every one of** the apples in this box is rotten!
sentences.translation: Bu qutidagi olmalarning **har biri** chirigan!

sentences.text: **Each of** my grandchildren **is** special in their own way.
sentences.translation: Nevaralarimning **har biri** o'ziga xos.

sentences.text: The manager thanked **every one of** us for working late.
sentences.translation: Menejer kechgacha ishlaganimiz uchun **har birimizga** rahmat aytdi.

sentences.text: Oliver has eaten at **each of** the restaurants on this street.
sentences.translation: Oliver bu ko'chadagi restoranlarning **har birida** ovqatlanib ko'rgan.

sentences.text: **Everyone** enjoyed the cakes, and **every one** of them was eaten.
sentences.translation: Tortlar **hammaga** yoqdi, ularning **har biri** yeb bo'lindi.

sentences.text: Did **each of** you get a copy of the agenda?
sentences.translation: **Har biringiz** kun tartibining nusxasini oldingizmi?

sentences.text: The students presented their projects, and **each of** them **was** excellent.
sentences.translation: Talabalar loyihalarini taqdim etishdi, ularning **har biri** a'lo darajada **edi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza answered **every one of** the 200 messages she got on her birthday.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza tug'ilgan kunida kelgan 200 ta xabarning **har biriga** javob yozdi.

examples.title: **each** without a noun: £5 **each**, they **each** ...
examples.description: each otsiz ham keladi: gap oxirida (They cost ten pounds each), egadan keyin (They each have a car), be / yordamchi fe'ldan keyin (We were each given a map). every bunday ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: These T-shirts cost twelve pounds **each**.
sentences.translation: Bu futbolkalarning **donasi** o'n ikki funt turadi.

sentences.text: We had two pieces of cake **each**, and then we felt sick.
sentences.translation: **Har birimiz** ikki bo'lakdan tort yedik, keyin ko'nglimiz aynidi.

sentences.text: My brothers **each** have their own business in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Akalarimning **har biri** Toshkentda o'z biznesiga ega.

sentences.text: The winners were **each** given a medal and a certificate.
sentences.translation: G'oliblarning **har biriga** medal va sertifikat berildi.

sentences.text: Tickets are fifteen pounds **each**, or fifty for a family of four.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar **donasi** o'n besh funt yoki to'rt kishilik oila uchun ellik funt.

sentences.text: Sarah and Emma **each** wrote a chapter of the report.
sentences.translation: Sara va Emma hisobotning **bittadan** bobini yozishdi.

sentences.text: The children got three sweets **each** from their grandmother.
sentences.translation: Bolalarning **har biri** buvisidan uchtadan konfet oldi.

sentences.text: We have **each** made mistakes in the past, so let's not judge him.
sentences.translation: **Har birimiz** o'tmishda xato qilganmiz, shuning uchun uni qoralamaylik.

sentences.text: There are four rooms upstairs, and **each** has a view of the lake.
sentences.translation: Yuqori qavatda to'rtta xona bor, **har biridan** ko'l ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: The guide gave us a map **each** and told us to meet at the gate at five.
sentences.translation: Gid **har birimizga** bittadan xarita berib, soat beshda darvoza oldida uchrashishimizni aytdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a team trip
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb jamoaviy sayohatni rejalashtiradi: each va every — birma-bir va hammasi birga.

sentences.text: — Right, **every** member of the team has confirmed they're coming on Friday.
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, jamoaning **har bir** a'zosi juma kuni kelishini tasdiqladi.

sentences.text: — Great. Should we book a separate room for **each** person?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. **Har bir** odamga alohida xona band qilaylikmi?

sentences.text: — No, that's too expensive. Two people can share **each** room.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, bu juda qimmat. **Har bir** xonada ikki kishidan yashasa bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — OK. And the train tickets are thirty pounds **each**, aren't they?
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Poyezd chiptalari esa **donasi** o'ttiz funt, shundaymi?

sentences.text: — Yes, and the company pays for **every** ticket, so that's fine.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **har bir** chiptani kompaniya to'laydi, demak muammo yo'q.

sentences.text: — What about meals? Do we give **each of** them a daily allowance?
sentences.translation: — Ovqat-chi? Ularning **har biriga** kunlik pul beramizmi?

sentences.text: — I think so. Last year **almost every** restaurant we chose was too pricey.
sentences.translation: — Menimcha, ha. O'tgan yili biz tanlagan **deyarli har bir** restoran juda qimmat edi.

sentences.text: — True. We'll **each** get twenty pounds a day, and people can eat where they like.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. **Har birimiz** kuniga yigirma funt olamiz, odamlar xohlagan joyida ovqatlanadi.

sentences.text: — Perfect. I'll send **everyone** an email with the details tonight.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Bugun kechqurun **hammaga** tafsilotlar bilan xat yuboraman.

sentences.text: — And remind them to check **every** item on the packing list!
sentences.translation: — Yuk ro'yxatidagi **har bir** narsani tekshirishni ham eslatib qo'ying!

examples.title: Mixed: **each** or **every**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: each va every — qachon ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, qachon faqat bittasi.

sentences.text: **Each** passenger is allowed one piece of hand luggage on **every** flight.
sentences.translation: **Har bir** yo'lovchiga **har bir** reysda bitta qo'l yuki olishga ruxsat beriladi.

sentences.text: The nurse checks **each** patient's temperature **every** four hours.
sentences.translation: Hamshira **har bir** bemorning haroratini **har to'rt soatda** o'lchaydi.

sentences.text: **Every** player in the team trained hard, and **each** of them deserved the trophy.
sentences.translation: Jamoadagi **har bir** o'yinchi qattiq mashq qildi, ularning **har biri** kubokka munosib edi.

sentences.text: Bekzod has two phones, and he carries one in **each** pocket.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning ikkita telefoni bor, ularni **ikkala** cho'ntagida bittadan olib yuradi.

sentences.text: I've checked **every** page of the contract, but I can't find the mistake.
sentences.translation: Shartnomaning **har bir** sahifasini tekshirdim, lekin xatoni topa olmayapman.

sentences.text: Visitors were **each** given a headset so that they could hear the guide.
sentences.translation: Tashrif buyuruvchilarning **har biriga** gidni eshitishlari uchun quloqchin berildi.

sentences.text: **Almost every** shop in the centre closes early on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Markazdagi **deyarli har bir** do'kon yakshanba kunlari erta yopiladi.

sentences.text: The two brothers **each** inherited a house from their uncle in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Ikki aka-ukaning **har biri** Farg'onadagi amakisidan bittadan uy meros qilib oldi.

sentences.text: Emma sends her grandmother a postcard from **every** city she visits.
sentences.translation: Emma borgan **har bir** shahridan buvisiga otkritka yuboradi.

sentences.text: **Each** time I call the bank, I have to explain the problem from the beginning.
sentences.translation: Bankka **har safar** qo'ng'iroq qilganimda muammoni boshidan tushuntirishimga to'g'ri keladi.
